name: free-agent-connector
description: Reads FreeAgent contacts, invoices, bills, projects, and tasks through the FreeAgent v2 REST API using OAuth2 refresh-token authentication. In architecture v2 this quarantine bundle dispatches live reads through a Tier-2 hook that delegates to the legacy connector until the wave 6 cutover.

risk.read: external FreeAgent API reads performed by the legacy connector via a Tier-2 hook
